Retirees::AY2.formula: IF(OR(AV2="0",AV2="9"),CONCATENATE("Joint-and-",AX2*100,"% Survivor Annuity",IF(AV2="0"," with Pop-up","")),IF(AV2="5",CONCATENATE(ROUND(AW2/12,2),"-Year Certain-and-Continuous Annuity"),IF(AV2="4",CONCATENATE(ROUND(AW2/12,2),"-Year Certain Annuity"),"Straight Life Annuity")))

Separated Vesteds::CJ2.formula: IF(OR(BX2="0",BX2="9"),CONCATENATE("Joint-and-",CB2*100,"% Survivor Annuity",IF(BX2="0"," with Pop-up","")),IF(BX2="5",CONCATENATE(ROUND(CF2/12,4),"-Year Certain-and-Continuous Annuity"),"Straight Life Annuity"))

Separated Vesteds::DG2.formula: IF(AND(BX2=BQ2, CC2=CF2),IF(E2="1", 1, CX2),IF(AND(L2>0,L2>DOPT,G2="R"),CX2, IF(AND(F2="DOR",OR(CZ2="OSF", CZ2="OMF")), DE2,CW2)))

Separated Vesteds::DH2.formula: IF(AND(F2="DOR", BO2<DOTR), AO2, IF(OR(E2="2",F2="QPSA"),ROUND(BK2*CR2*CV2*CX2*QPSAPercent,2), ROUND(BK2*CR2*CV2*IF(L2>DOPT, CX2, DG2),2)))
